title: Bristol Grade School
subtitle: Washington, D.C. April 26-30, 2027
bodyHtml:
Families, you are currently viewing a sample itinerary customized for Bristol Grade School. Please note that this version is meant to provide a general overview of the experiences and activities the trip organizers hope to include. As we get closer to departure, the school or designated trip organizer will share the most up-to-date and finalized itinerary, reflecting any adjustments, confirmed reservations, and timing updates. For now, please enjoy this preview of what is planned for your student’s upcoming trip.

Day 1: Travel to Washington, D.C. & National Museum of American History

  • Travel to Washington, D.C.!
  • Lunch Allocation
  • Visit the National Museum of American History
  • Visit The People’s House
  • White House Photo Opportunity Stop from Lafayette Park/Pennsylvania Avenue
  • Dinner Allocation
  • Visit the Lincoln Memorial, Vietnam, and Korean War Memorials, World War II Memorial, and Washington Monument
  • Check-in to Hotel Accommodations with Overnight Security (four nights)
 

Day 2: Mount Vernon & National Archives Museum

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit George Washington’s Mount Vernon
  • Lunch Allocation
  • Visit the National Archives Museum 
  • Visit the United States Holocaust Memorial Museum
  • DJ Dinner Cruise
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations 
 

Day 3: International Spy Museum & Tidal Basin Memorials Tour

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit the International Spy Museum 
  • Tour Director Led Walking Tour of Arlington National Cemetery 
  • Boxed Sandwich Lunch 
  • Visit the US Marine Corps War Memorial: Iwo Jima
  • Visit the Smithsonian Museum of Natural History
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Visit the Thomas Jefferson, Franklin Delano Roosevelt, and MLK Memorials around the Tidal Basin
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations

Day 4: Smithsonian National Zoological Park & United States Capitol Building

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit the Smithsonian National Zoological Park 
  • Lunch Allocation
  • Visit the United States Capitol Building
  • Visit the National Museum of African American History and Culture
  • Group sit-down dinner and Bowling!
  • Group Exploration of Pentagon City Mall
  • Visit the National 9/11 Pentagon Memorial 
 

Day 5: Departure for Home

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Departure for Home
introHeading: Bristol Grade School, get ready for an unforgettable Washington, D.C. adventure in 2027! 🏛️
introText: From iconic memorials and powerful museums to unforgettable evenings in the nation’s capital, this Washington, D.C. experience brings history to life at every turn. Students will explore landmarks like the Lincoln Memorial, Arlington National Cemetery, and the U.S. Capitol while discovering inspiring stories at the National Museum of African American History and Culture, the National Archives, and Smithsonian museums. They’ll also enjoy memorable moments like a White House photo stop and an evening cruise through the city. It’s the perfect mix of learning, reflection, and excitement—an experience your students will never forget!
